fields.type: number (whole naira) when kind naira; YYYY-MM-DD string when kind date

fields.name: from
fields.type: string (sample provenance: the lib file the figure was read from)

filtersOrSort: grouped client-side in fixed order offer, tickets, extras, keeps, pass, pro, pack, vault, studio
reads.note: The screen also computes notes client side: extras show '₦X with 40% off' using OFF from lib/maker.ts; others show 'List ₦X' from list. The 'The 40% off ends' row is a date price. Prices are currently constants in the web app's lib files, so the server must become their source (conventions: prices are read from configuration tables).

fields.name: from
fields.type: string (formatted old value e.g. ₦7,000 or '31 Jan 2027')

reads.note: from/to arrive as formatted display strings in the sample; the screen prints them as is

actions.name: set-price

payload.name: value
payload.type: number (whole naira, > 0 and <= 10,000,000, typed with optional ₦ and commas) or YYYY-MM-DD string for the date row (the UI accepts 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'D Mon YYYY')

payload.name: reason
payload.type: string (trimmed, 4 or more characters; the Confirm dialog disables the button below 4, the seam throws 'failed')

actions.note: Seam refuses (failed) an empty value, a value equal to the current one, or a value whose type differs from the price's; not_found for an unknown key. 'The new price holds for every payment after it'. Writes an audit entry with old and new value, who and why. The UI also blocks 'That is the price now.' and malformed input before the dialog button enables.
actions.evidence: PUT /v1/admin/prices/:key { value, reason } -> Price. The new price holds for every payment after it; it is written to the audit log with the old and new value, who and why.

authContext.note: Roles from lib/admin/d-fixtures.ts access table (marked 'Default (lead), owner may override'). Staff sign-in is a six-digit code (admin-api.ts verifyCode accepts any six digits in sample), kept in memory only.

notes: ops is excluded from /admin/prices in the access table
the date price (offer end) is a calendar date, not a timestamp
input parsing (readPrice/parseDay) lives in the client

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: !data: Loading (prices); the changes block has its own Loading while log is null
uiStatesHandled.reachable: no today (the seam is an async function over in-memory data and resolves in a microtask); yes once a real request exists

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: prices read rejects: Problem + retry (the changes log has no error state)
log.length===0: 'No price has been changed on this page yet.'
none coded; a group with no rows is skipped
grouped price lists with Change buttons

uiStatesHandled.reachable: yes after a change this session

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: raw typed and not ok: 'Write a whole naira amount, like 7000.' / 'Write a day like 31 Jan 2027.' / 'That is the price now.'

stubsObserved.consequence: every figure and every change is fixture/in-memory; a reload loses staff changes; the header says 'Sample data'

stubsObserved.consequence: a price change on this screen changes nothing the site charges; the site still uses its own constants
